domain: Local topological link prediction by triangle completion

interface.description: Simple undirected topology, nodes 0..node_count-1. train_edges and candidates are [u,v], u<v. Return finite scores in candidate order. Required candidate artifacts are solution.py defining score_candidates(adj, candidates) and method_manifest.json declaring the executable JSON command. The solution.py module must run unchanged in the original evaluator. A CLI adapter may have any filename or be implemented in solution.py; no solve.py filename is required. Use target_runtime.py as an interface example. Deterministic Python/NumPy, observed topology only. Labels and split metadata are controller-only during evaluation.

cn.source: Sender baselines.py::common_neighbors, unchanged definition plus CLI wrapper

ra.source: Sender baselines.py::resource_allocation, unchanged definition plus CLI wrapper

aa.source: Sender baselines.py::adamic_adar, unchanged definition plus CLI wrapper

seed_policy.rule: Two distinct method seeds, separate from all split and graph seeds. Methods are deterministic and must ignore method seed.

preprocessing: Sender sampling and distance-2 candidate enumeration are unchanged. test_fraction=0.1; no candidate truncation. Splits are precomputed once. AP groups tied thresholds exactly as sklearn; Hits@L is stable by candidate index whereas the sender uses default np.argsort; AUC uses tie-aware ranks.
stopping_rule: Return one finite numeric score for every candidate within 60 seconds.
hyperparameter_selection: Use only three real public graph families, eight quality splits each. Separate synthetic runtime envelopes do not contribute to quality. Hidden graphs/splits are unchanged from v1.
